description: The village square is a bright paved meeting place built around a circular fountain. Half-timbered shopfronts surround it: the bakery lies on the upper left, the apothecary farther back, and the blue-roofed Larkspur Goods storefront fills the right side. Flower boxes, shrubs and climbing plants soften the stone paving. Wooden benches and black lamp posts line the lower paths, while steps lead upwards between the houses. The fountain basin and the shop awnings give the square its strongest landmarks; the winding lanes remain open between them, linking the nearby tavern, shops and the routes beyond the village.

landmarks.label: Village fountain
landmarks.description: A circular stone basin and central fountain stand in the upper-middle part of the square.

landmarks.label: Larkspur storefront
landmarks.description: A blue-roofed shop with a striped awning and a large Larkspur Goods sign fills the right side.

landmarks.label: Bakery awning
landmarks.description: The bakery on the upper left has a striped awning and goods set outside.

landmarks.label: Apothecary frontage
landmarks.description: A narrow timber-fronted apothecary stands beyond the fountain.

landmarks.label: Lower benches and lamps
landmarks.description: Wooden benches, dark lamp posts and flower beds edge the lower paved paths.
